title: A Family Visit and a Shopping List
instructions: 这是为A1学习者设计的原创模拟听力与语法练习，不是官方雅思考试。请先听或读对话，注意 we / they、are、规则复数、my / your / his / her、have / has 的用法。然后完成8道听力题和8道语法题。听力题请根据对话内容选择或填空；填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。语法题请根据新句子选择正确答案。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. My sister and her family are here.
Ben: Nice! Are they in your house now?
Mia: Yes, they are. We have two guests. My sister has a son and a daughter.
Ben: Do they have a car?
Mia: No, they don't. They have two bikes. My sister's son is Tom. He has a red bike.
Ben: And her daughter?
Mia: Her name is Lily. She has a small bag. We need food for dinner. We have eggs and rice, but we don't have apples.
Ben: I have a list. We need six apples and three tomatoes.
Mia: Good. Your list is on the table. His bag is here, too.
Ben: OK. Let's go to the shop.

grammar.title: we / they + are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has
grammar.explanation: 我们先看意思：we 是“我们”，they 是“他们/她们/它们”。be 动词用 are，例如 We are here. They are here. 否定是 We are not here. They are not here. 一般疑问句把 are 放前面：Are they here? 规则复数一般加 -s，例如 apple → apples，tomato → tomatoes（以 o 结尾有些加 -es）。my 是“我的”，your 是“你的/你们的”，his 是“他的”，her 是“她的”。have 用于 I / you / we / they，has 用于 he / she / it。例如 I have a list. She has a bag. 否定用 don't have 或 doesn't have。
grammar.example: We have two guests. My sister has a son and a daughter.

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，be 动词用 are。
